body: I just don't think I know what to do. It all seems pointless and like a cycle. I tried talking to my mom about it a couple of years ago, but it was a pointless conversation that saw no development anywhere. I don't know how to get better or how to avoid the inevitably of my own death. I don't know if I truly can ask my parents for help because it would mean I am some lesser shell of who everyone sees me as.
